# Astronomical 0.2.80
## What's new
- **Fixed: text-only folded ternary pack variants now load.** A real installed export of the folded ternary family (the text-only DFlash2 variant of schema version 2) was refused with a model-load failure on 0.2.79; the loader now accepts that export's omitted runtime marker and Transformers metadata, and validation failures carry their cause. Model output is unchanged — the upstream greedy parity journey still replays token for token. - **Release hardening behind the scenes**: releases now round-trip every installed chat model (a sampled one-hundred-token reply from each) before shipping, so a pack variant the loader would refuse is caught at release time.
## Compatibility
- macOS 14.0 and later on Apple silicon (arm64). - Existing configuration, state, and installed models are preserved; no migration is required.
## Distribution
- The application and every nested executable are signed with Astronomical's Developer ID Application certificate (Hardened Runtime, timestamped), and the disk image is notarized with Apple and carries a stapled notarization ticket. - Existing installs receive this update through the signed Sparkle feed; new installs download `Astronomical-0.2.80-macOS-arm64.dmg` from the releases page.
